This document outlines the 
testing procedure P1, which must be performed every 6 months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.

The IAV relays are single phase, voltage operated induction disk relays 
 with time delay, The type IAV51A ( 64 B ) is an over voltage relay used to 
 protect the generator bus bar from ground faults. The type IAV51K ( 64 G ) 
 is a low pick up voltage relay used for ground fault protection It is of the 
 same construction except that it has a capacitor and tapped resistor giving 
 a low pick up voltage.

The first sheet is done by 
eng. Fayza El-Sharkawy, tested at 24 April 2003 by eng Shirin Hamdy & Azza

text:
Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
testing procedure P1, which must be performed every 6 months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.
The IAV relays are single phase, voltage operated induction disk relays 
 with time delay, The type IAV51A ( 64 B ) is an over voltage relay used to 
 protect the generator bus bar from ground faults. The type IAV51K ( 64 G ) 
 is a low pick up voltage relay used for ground fault protection It is of the 
 same construction except that it has a capacitor and tapped resistor giving 
 a low pick up voltage.
The first sheet is done by 
eng. Fayza El-Sharkawy, tested at 24 April 2003 by eng Shirin Hamdy & Azza 
Salama, reviewed by quality control eng..Adel Abd EL Kader EL Nagar of EDEP COM, accepted by general director 
eng. Mahmoud Sakr, and approved by eng. Mustafa Alaam Sector Head
The first update initiated by eng. Fayza El- Sharkawy, tested by eng. Shirin 
 Hamdy & eng. Azza Salama , at 24 April 2008 , revised by MDEP Co. quality 
 control eng. Adel El-Nagar , accepted by General Director eng. Mohamed Anber, 
 and approved by eng. Farouk Awad Ali Head Sector of Talkha Power Station, 
 coordinate eng. Samir Abd El gleel. Head sector of quality control eng.
Mohamed Nageeb.
Safety Precautions
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area
A work permit must be issued & the 
 staff of test must be qualified and carry the suitable safety precautions.
The generator must be out of 
 service.
Tools and Equipment
Test Plug handle and test Leads.
Secondary injection test set
Work to be Carried Out
Preparation
Make Sure P.T secondary circuit are opened at the incoming terminal blocks 
 before isolating the relay voltage circuit for test.
Obtain copy of relay setting from 
 field maintenance file and compare it with the setting on the relay.
Testing the Relay
For Bus Bar Ground 
Relay (51A)
Connect the test leads between the voltage terminals ( 5 - 6 ) . 
 figure (1)
Connect the test leads between the relay contact ( relay trip ) ( 1 , 2 ) 
 figure (1)
Increase the voltage until the 
 relay picks up .
Record this voltage value in 
 the test sheet as the relay start
Increase the voltage to the 
 values ( 100 % , 120 % , 140 % , to 220 % ) of rated value .
Record the time values each 
 time in the test sheet .
Increase the voltage values ( 30 , 40 , 50 , 60 . 65 ) and record the trip 
 time at
 each voltage value in the test sheet.
Connect the test leads between the voltage terminals ( 3 6 ) . 
 figure (2)
Repeat the steps from 2 to 4 .
Increase the voltage values ( 30 , 40 , 50 , 60 . 65 ) and record the trip 
 time at
 each voltage value in the test sheet.
The steps for putting the relay into service
Check that the CT and PT secondary connections return to its normal position as 
before the test.

Ground Relay
